classification.difficultyReason: Compare two nets, notice that both circles are on one side in B, and give a reason.

content.prompt:
Which of these nets folds to make a cylinder?

Give a reason for your answer.

answer.worked:
In net A, the circles are joined to opposite sides of the rectangle, so they form the two ends of the cylinder.

In net B, both circles are joined to the same side of the rectangle. They would both cover the same end, leaving the other end open.
